## Custom Roleplay Bot for PRC's ER: LC
- Contains API Commands
- Uses discord.py's v1 Embeds
- Requires the ER: LC API Pack

### Commands:
- /players 
   - Used to see who is in-game!
   - Shows what staff members are in-game. 
   - Shows what team players are on.
   - Shows who in the the queue. 
- /check
   - For staff only! (Role Hardcoded)
   - Shows who is in the discord and who is not.
- /check wl
   - Shows who is using Whitelisted weapons, cars, etc. (Hardcoded)
   - For staff Only!
